steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Team Hella has snatched its first victory! And the MVP is... Captain Hella!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Damn, why did they turn around? They can't beat us so they flee like cowards! We can't let them get away!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Understood! V-710, enable auxiliary aim and fire mode.

steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: Command successfully received. Automatically searching for enemy targets. Targets within range locked. Ready to fire.
Boom boom! Boom boom boom! Boom!
The V-710 chases after the fleeing guerrilla boats and shoots them down one by one. The desert bandits fall from the ships like flies, trapped by Hecate's Nightmare.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, all targets have been defeated. Attention, the desert bandits' fleet is retreating.
This victory is too easy.You gaze at the fleeing enemies, wondering to yourself. How did these easily beatable desert bandits make so much trouble for DisCity?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, if we stop chasing them now, the target fleet will escape.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What are you hesitating for, dummy? Even if we get ambushed by more desert bandits, they would be no match for the V-710.

Information and knowledge on WhiteSands in DisCity is limited. The files given to you by the Outland Affairs Bureau also have no conclusive data about the desert bandits. You cannot guarantee a victory if you continue the chase.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Kawa-kawa, is the direction in which they flee a safe route?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Let me see... huh? This direction seems to have no existing routes!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Let's not make any rash moves. The first priority of navigating WhiteSands is to make sure the route is safe! V-710, retrieve satellite imagery of the area that the desert bandits are fleeing towards.
Satellite imagery appear before your eyes. The scenes depicted make all of you gulp and shudder.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh... What are those disgusting worms? Oh gosh, I'm getting goosebumps all over...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Those are sandworms. They are the most commonly found creatures in WhiteSands and usually live underground.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Then why did they come to the surface? Just taking some fresh air?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Oh no! According to my grandpa's records, when sandworms show signs of mass agitation, it means the Tide of Ashes is going to arrive!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: We'd better find shelter now and hide from the Tide of Ashes. Otherwise, if we are caught in the storm, everyone's life will be in grave danger.
Kawa-kawa leads everyone back into the cockpit, opens the map and searches for the nearest shelter. He then charts a safe route to venture through.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, is that tide thing really that scary? Even the V-710 can't withstand it? Didn't you say this ship could protect us?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: The V-710's Hypercube force field can indeed protect us while navigating through sandstorms. However...
Kawa-kawa pauses and raises his head. His childlike face is twisted into a frown, causing everyone to worry.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: If we run into the Tide of Ashes... then it's a whole different story.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Isn't that just a big sandstorm? What's the difference?

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: In the depths of the Tide of Ashes... there is an unknown horror...

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: The Apostle of Ashes...
Kawa-kawa flips open his notebook and shows you a pencil sketch.

The black and gray pencil marks scrawled all over the paper are so oppressive that it makes one hard to breathe... several colossal silhouettes loom in the suffocating darkness, squeezed one next to another, surging forward...

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: No one has ever seen what the Apostle of Ashes looks like, but those who narrowly escaped death from the Tide of Ashes have seen huge, ominous black shadows wandering in its depths.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: The survivors describe them like this: "They are like messengers of the gods searching for lost followers, leading them to their deaths in the tide." This explains the origin of the name "Apostle of Ashes"...
Kawa-kawa gazes into the distance, scratching his head awkwardly.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: But actually, I've always wanted to see the heart of the Tide of Ashes, but... it would be too dangerous for you.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I have no way of ensuring everyone's safety.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: I hope this kind of fictitious urban legend isn't discouraging anyone from the MBCC?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Gosh... Where did you come from? You know in that kind of atmosphere just now, you could scare someone to death by popping out like that!
Guillotin raises his eyebrows in displeasure at Hella's outburst.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: It is the responsibility and duty of the Outland Affairs Bureau to discipline those who desert their posts in the face of battle, regardless of time or place.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh?! Who are you accusing of desertion?

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: The enemies that have been plaguing DisCity are within reach. This is the best chance to wipe out the desert bandits once and for all. If you give up the chase now because of a mere Tide of Ashes, it would be hard for the Outland Affairs Bureau to not be suspicious...
Guillotin pauses for a moment, his eyes darting through the group before finally fixing his gaze on Kawa-kawa.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: First you arranged the ship, then you arranged the crew, and now you're letting go of the best chance to catch the enemy... It's obvious! Quinn is behind this conspiracy!

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: I have all the evidence I need! They are the treacherous traitors who colluded with the Outlands and desert bandits to sabotage state-sponsored Hypercube trade!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh?! What the hell are you talking about, old man?! Put your money where your mouth is and come chase them with us!

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: This is your mission. Not mine.

steps.speaker: Guillotin
steps.content: In any case! Quitting this chase is not an option! We want to see results from your mission immediately!
He spits out this vicious warning before hanging up the comms.
Now that the V-710's freighter disguise has been exposed, the desert bandits won't come near it again. This is indeed the only chance to approach the bandits.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: Chief, it's too dangerous! Are you sure?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: As long as we wipe out the desert bandits before the Tide of Ashes arrives, we'll be fine.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Kawa-kawa, please do everything you can to help us.
Sensing that your mind is made up, Kawa-kawa pats you on the shoulder and laughs.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: My father once told me, "The most dangerous thing in the world is not taking risks." You're a gutsy one, and I love that!

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: V-710, stay on course and chase them down!

steps.speaker: V-710 Central System
steps.content: Understood.

steps.speaker: Kawa-kawa
steps.content: I will try my best to avoid the sandworms and keep everyone safe!
A huge sand dune looms ahead, completely blocking the desert bandits' path.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmph! Finally, they hit a dead end! These guys are too good at fleeing!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, time is running out.

A sky-high wall of sand has already risen in the horizon. You immediately order Kawa-kawa to prepare fire support to eliminate the desert bandits in one swoop. But to your surprise, several desert bandits came out from a nearby boat to sneer at you.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
steps.content: Hahaha! Did you have fun chasing us, you "DisGusting" lackeys? Did you think we were dead and can't escape?

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Captain
steps.content: It's a pity that the ones dying here today... are you!
